categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of touch modules, touch module displays, and conductive glass products. It also engages in precision optoelectronic module assembly, 3D printing of consumer product components, and automotive LiDAR product assembly. The business extends to new ventures such as 3D printing, laser radar, energy storage systems, and lightweight energy vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in projected capacitive touch technology with proprietary processes including double-sided ITO coating, nano-silver coating, photolithography, laser engraving, glass cutting, and precision lamination of optical films and LCD panels. It also develops advanced materials and manufacturing techniques such as 3D glass and film sensor bonding, multi-layer anti-reflective coatings, ultra-thin and narrow bezel touch modules, and high-precision lamination technologies. The company integrates MES and SAP systems for quality and material management and holds over 3,300 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global consumer electronics brands requiring touch solutions for smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearable devices, e-readers, automotive central control screens, and interactive electronic whiteboards. The company also serves new markets including automotive LiDAR, 3D printed sports and medical products, and energy vehicles. The end markets are primarily consumer electronics, automotive, industrial control, and commercial display sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with significant manufacturing facilities in Xiamen and Pingtan, China, and a new plant under construction in Thailand. It has subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, the United States, and Malaysia, serving customers globally with major sales in Asia and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company occupies a midstream to downstream position in the supply chain, providing vertically integrated services from raw material processing (glass substrates, conductive films) through touch sensor manufacturing, module assembly, and integration with display panels. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials and downstream system integrators and brand customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in touch technology and materials, expanding applications to new markets such as automotive LiDAR and 3D printing, and enhancing manufacturing efficiency through automation and smart manufacturing. The company emphasizes patent development, customer co-development, and diversification into new business areas while maintaining leadership in core touch technologies. Sustainability and ESG integration are also key R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of touch modules, touch sensors, conductive glass, and related optoelectronic components. The company also earns income from engineering services, especially in automotive LiDAR and 3D printing sectors. Licensing and patent-related revenues are implied but not explicitly detailed.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the projected capacitive touch industry, recognized for its advanced technology and manufacturing capabilities. The touch industry has consolidated with few major players remaining, and the company maintains a strong market position through innovation, vertical integration, and close customer relationships. Competitors are other major touch solution providers, but the company differentiates itself with proprietary technologies and diversified applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$68.9 billion, a slight decline of 1.4% from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$470 million, representing a 127% increase. The company employs around 11,000 people, down from 13,000 in 2023, reflecting operational optimization. Despite market challenges, the company maintains a stable financial structure and continues to invest in R&D with expenditures around 0.7% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, high-performance touch solutions with superior sensitivity, thinness, and integration capabilities tailored to diverse end-user applications. Its vertical integration from materials to module assembly enables rapid time-to-market and high production yields. The company’s strong patent portfolio, innovation in new materials and processes, and expansion into emerging fields like automotive LiDAR and 3D printing provide competitive differentiation and added value to customers.
